findings.claim: Ownly is a zero-commission platform for restaurants in India.
findings.evidence: The Ownly app is designed as a zero-commission platform, offering customers meals at prices comparable to those in physical restaurants, while also reducing costs for restaurant partners by eliminating hidden fees, Moneycontrol has reported.

findings.claim: Food delivery apps generally charge restaurants a commission ranging between 15% and 30% of gross order value.
findings.evidence: Commission structures vary significantly by platform, market, service tier, and restaurant size, but the general range sits between 15% and 30% of gross order value for full-service marketplace arrangements.
